nodes.description: Owned.owner (address public). Holds the contract owner, set to msg.sender at deployment, changed in acceptOwnership.
Owned.newOwner (address public). Pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed/cleared by acceptOwnership.
AUMToken.symbol (string public) = "AUM", set in constructor.
AUMToken.name (string public) = "AUM Token", set in constructor.
AUMToken.decimals (uint8 public) = 18, set in constructor.
AUMToken._totalSupply (uint public). Total minted supply; read by totalSupply() and written in the constructor.
AUMToken.balances mapping(address => uint). Token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom via SafeMath.
AUMToken.allowed mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)). ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): c = a + b; require(c >= a). Overflow-guarded addition.
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): require(b <= a); c = a - b. Underflow-guarded subtraction.
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): c = a * b; require(a == 0 || c / a == b). Overflow-guarded multiplication.
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): require(b > 0); c = a / b.
Owned() constructor: owner = msg.sender (deployer becomes owner, unrestricted).
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner). Access-control gate used by transferOwnership and transferAnyERC20Token.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: sets newOwner (two-step transfer, no immediate effect).
Owned.acceptOwnership(): require(msg.sender == newOwner); emits OwnershipTransferred; owner = newOwner; newOwner = address(0).
AUMToken() constructor: sets symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply (1e26) and credits the full supply to the fixed deployer address.
AUMToken.totalSupply() constant: returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
AUMToken.balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant: returns balances[tokenOwner].
AUMToken.transfer(address to, uint tokens): safeSub from balances[msg.sender], safeAdd to balances[to], emits Transfer.
AUMToken.approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, emits Approval (no double-spend check).
AUMToken.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): safeSub on balances[from] and on allowed[from][msg.sender], safeAdd on balances[to], emits Transfer.
AUMToken.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant: returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
AUMToken.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): writes allowance, emits Approval and calls spender.receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data).
AUMToken fallback function () public payable { revert(); }. Rejects ETH.
AUMToken.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: performs an arbitrary external ERC20 call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
msg.sender consumed by the Owned constructor and the AUMToken constructor context (deployer).
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier (privilege check).
msg.sender compared against newOwner inside acceptOwnership (second step of ownership transfer).
msg.sender used as token holder/spender in transfer, approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall (indexes balances/allowed).
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply(); no SafeMath guard is applied here.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an arbitrary, attacker-controlled contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary, attacker-supplied token contract.

Parameter 'tokens' of AUMToken.transfer (amount).

Parameter 'to' of AUMToken.transferFrom (credited account).

Parameter 'tokens' of AUMToken.approveAndCall.
Parameter 'data' of AUMToken.approveAndCall, forwarded verbatim to the callee.

edges.reason: Owned constructor reads msg.sender to establish the initial owner.
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender (unrestricted initialization).
onlyOwner modifier compares untrusted msg.sender against the stored owner value.
onlyOwner modifier reads the owner state variable for the comparison.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter _newOwner flows into transferOwnership and is stored as the pending owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner (two-step ownership hand-off, no immediate privilege change).
acceptOwnership requires untrusted msg.sender to equal newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership reads the newOwner state variable for the authorization check.
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner = address(0).
AUMToken constructor initializes symbol.
AUMToken constructor initializes name.
AUMToken constructor initializes decimals.
AUMToken constructor mints _totalSupply = 100000000 * 10**18.
AUMToken constructor credits the full supply to the hard-coded deployer address in balances.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)] and subtracts it.
_totalSupply participates in the unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)]; no SafeMath guard is used.
Result of the unchecked subtraction is returned by totalSupply().
Parameter tokenOwner flows into balanceOf.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
Parameter 'to' flows into transfer as the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' flows into transfer as the amount.
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to] (overflow/underflow guarded by SafeMath).
transfer calls safeSub for the sender balance decrement.
transfer calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
Parameter spender flows into approve.
Parameter tokens flows into approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens (no double-spend protection by design).
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance check and decrement.
Parameter 'from' flows into transferFrom as the debited account.
Parameter 'to' flows into transferFrom as the credited account.
Parameter 'tokens' flows into transferFrom as the amount.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to] (guarded by SafeMath).
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender] (guarded by SafeMath).
transferFrom calls safeSub twice (balance and allowance decrement).
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
Parameter tokenOwner flows into allowance.
Parameter spender flows into allowance.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and as the 'from' argument of the callback.
Parameter spender flows into approveAndCall and is used as the callee address.
Parameter tokens flows into approveAndCall and into the callback payload.
Parameter data flows into approveAndCall and is forwarded verbatim to the external callee.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling callback re-entry into AUMToken.
The receiveApproval external call can call back into AUMToken (transfer/approve/transferFrom/approveAndCall) while state is manipulable.
Parameter tokenAddress flows into transferAnyERC20Token and becomes the called contract address.
Parameter tokens flows into transferAnyERC20Token as the transfer amount.
transferAnyERC20Token sends the recovered tokens to the owner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an attacker-supplied token contract address (arbitrary call target).
The arbitrary token contract invoked through ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer can call back into AUMToken.
